title: Motion-Picture Film (16-mm) - Magnetic Audio Records - Two Records on 16-mm Magnetic Film
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the lateral positions and width dimensions of two 3.81 mm (0.150 in) magnetic audio records and a control track on 16-mm single-perforated magnetic recording film. 1.2 This standard also specifies the reproducing velocity of the film travel.
